note: Every number below was measured in this project. 'Same period' = random 20% of 2023 rows held out. 'Recalibrated' = train on 2022 plus a random 10% of 2023 flight-days, test on the other 2023 flight-days. Accuracy = 100 - mean absolute percentage error.

feature_ladder.step: Base features (airline, route, class, stops, duration, time bucket, days left, weekday, month)
+ route supply (flights per route and class)

first_version.split: Time split inside 2023 (last 20% of journey dates)
first_version.caveat: Because each scrape has one booking date, journey date and days-left are the same signal, so this really tests days-left 30-50 only.

findings: Almost every flight-day has exactly one price once exact times are used (only 1.5% of rows have more than one), so the remaining error is day-to-day variation of individual flights, not label noise.
Economy fares are about 55% higher in the 2023 scrape than in 2022, which caps accuracy for any unseen period.
Each scrape has a single booking date, so the model never sees one flight's price change over time and cannot learn festival effects.
The 'same period' score is an interpolation score: other days of the same flights are in training.
